name: DBOVERCUSTTEXT
data: Use the interface below to manage alternate database connections. Alternate database connections are used within this software to provide access to database accounts other than the primary account configured during installation. Alternate connections allow for data management and are required by some import and upgrade modules.  If you would like to change the settings for the primary database connection used by this software, access the installer script you used to install the software on this webserver account.

name: DBOVERCUSTTEXT
data: Use the interface below to manage user groups.  If you wish to clone a group, use the Clone function.  The Clone function will copy all the permissions of the group you are cloning over to the new group you create.  If you choose to delete a group which contains users, those users will be reassigned to the Basic Account (users) group.
